items.name: talos/claw_link
items.note: The claw (talos.yaml claw:), the lowest point under the bow. The tree puts it on each table object.

items.name: talos/droppers_link
items.note: The marker droppers (talos.yaml droppers:). The tree holds it 1 m above a bin and drops.

items.name: talos/hitch_link
items.note: The frame the table task lines up over the table (RepairCompMpcTree). Its talos.yaml pose is all zeros, so it sits exactly on origin.

items.name: talos/magnet_link
items.note: Where the trees think the magnet is (talos.yaml magnet:); they fly it onto the magnet targets. The source files disagree about where the magnet really is.

items.name: talos/poker_link
items.note: The magnet poker's mount (talos.yaml poker:). No tree uses it; the trees fly magnet_link.

items.name: talos/torpedo_0_link
items.note: Torpedo tube 0, 17.5 mm to starboard of torpedo_link. The tree lines it up on the first hole.

items.name: talos/torpedo_1_link
items.note: Torpedo tube 1, 17.5 mm to port of torpedo_link. The tree lines it up on the second hole.

items.name: talos/torpedo_link
items.note: The torpedo launcher (talos.yaml torpedoes:). The two tube frames hang from it, 35 mm apart.

nodes.role: Turns the raw pressure depth into a pose for the EKF.

ch.sec: Depth: a pressure sensor in the starboard lid

nodes.role: Nortek DVL driver: reads the DVL over Ethernet (TCP) and publishes velocity and status.
Power-cycles the IMU through a Jetson GPIO pin when an electrical command asks for it.
Fibre-optic gyro (FOG) driver on /dev/ttyTHS2; turns raw counts into a yaw rate with a temperature model.
VectorNav IMU driver on /dev/ttyTHS1 (serial on the Orin HAT).
Downward ZED X Mini camera, configured like the forward one.
Forward ZED X Mini camera: images, depth, point cloud, camera info, SVO recording.
Saves forward-camera stereo frames for calibration. Subscribes to the raw stereo stream from launch: turn it off when not calibrating.
Container process that hosts both ZED nodes (ffc_zed_node and dfc_zed_node) as components: one process, so if it stops, both cameras stop.
EKF: fuses IMU, FOG, DVL and depth into odometry/filtered and the odom->base_link transform.
Joint states for the robot description.

ch.sec: Where the sensors sit: the URDF

nodes.role: Static world->odom transform.
Publishes the robot description and the sensor/thruster frames on Talos.

ch.sec: Where the sensors sit: the URDF

nodes.role: Publishes each ZED's own frames (camera centre, left and right lenses) under talos/<cam>_camera_link. Skipped where zed_wrapper isn't installed, so it was missing from the Nereus capture.
Drag calibration action server (calibrate_drag_new).
Controller supervisor: publishes controller/motion_enabled and the feed-forward body force, hosts parameter-update services for the older controllers, warns when thruster telemetry stops.
Model predictive controller: pose and velocity goals in. On Talos it sends RPM to the ESC boards over CAN itself; in Nereus the simulator applies its eight thruster forces (thruster_forces).

ch.sec: Where things live in the code

nodes.role: System identification in the pool: drives test manoeuvres through the MPC and fits a new model. Run by hand (pool_identify.launch.py).
Container for the AprilTag detector (on the robot started by hardware.launch.py; in sim added by Nereus mission_stack.launch.py).
AprilTag (36h11) detector on the front camera, for tag calibration of the map.
Static tag36h11:0 -> estimated_origin_frame transform.
YOLO detector on the active camera (ffc or dfc): detections with 3D poses from depth.

ch.page: Perception: The detector, frame by frame

nodes.role: Mapping: fuses detections into one pose estimate per course object (mapping/<object>, TF frames).
Publishes world->map on /tf_static; the map/set_transform service and map/model_tf action move it (AprilTag calibration).
Behavior-tree executor: autonomy/run_tree action, publishes the running stack.

actuator_service_translator.py, node name ActuatorTranslator. Serves the actuator services the trees call, publishes the topic of the same name for the POAC firmware, and replies with the board's state/actuator/cmd_status.
One-topic test shortcuts: arm if needed, fire or drop through the actuator services.
Camera cage board firmware (RP2040, micro-ROS over CAN through copro_agent).
micro-ROS agent on can0: carries every internal board's topics between CAN and ROS. The boards' topics appear as if published by their own nodes (below).
ESC boards (2) firmware (RP2040, micro-ROS over CAN through copro_agent).
IVC board firmware (RP2040, micro-ROS over CAN through copro_agent).
LED board firmware (RP2040, micro-ROS over CAN through copro_agent).
POAC board firmware (RP2040, micro-ROS over CAN through copro_agent).

nodes.role: Smart battery housing firmware, on the external CAN bus (can1). Its micro-ROS agent is commented out in copro_agent.launch.py, so nothing it publishes reaches ROS and nothing sent to it (kill, software kill, electrical commands) arrives.
IVC board firmware with the pinger listening mode (IVCBoard2, on branch blake/ivc).

Viewer plot windows (subscribes only to plotted topics).
Nereus simulator: 6-DOF physics, sensors (IMU, FOG, DVL, depth), both ZED cameras, actuators, task scoring. Stands in for the firmware boards and sensor drivers.
